verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for a cloud agent platform with a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting or flag. Scoped API keys and encrypted secrets are related security controls, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
